tables.name: azp_card_balances
tables.view:
SELECT c.id AS card_id,
    c.module,
    c.card_no,
    c.holder,
    c.project,
    c.active,
    c.sort_order,
    COALESCE(sum(m.amount) FILTER (WHERE m.kind = 'medaxil'::text), 0::numeric)::numeric(14,2) AS medaxil_total,
    COALESCE(sum(m.amount) FILTER (WHERE m.kind = 'mexaric'::text), 0::numeric)::numeric(14,2) AS mexaric_total,
    round(COALESCE(sum(m.amount) FILTER (WHERE m.kind = 'medaxil'::text), 0::numeric) - COALESCE(sum(m.amount) FILTER (WHERE m.kind = 'mexaric'::text), 0::numeric), 2) AS balance,
    count(m.id) FILTER (WHERE m.id IS NOT NULL) AS mov_count
   FROM azp_cards c
     LEFT JOIN azp_movements m ON m.card_id = c.id AND m.cancelled = false AND m.module = c.module
  GROUP BY c.id, c.module, c.card_no, c.holder, c.project, c.active, c.sort_order;

tables.name: balances
tables.view:
SELECT m.warehouse,
    m.item_code,
    i.name AS item_name,
    i.unit,
    sum(m.in_qty) AS total_in,
    sum(m.out_qty) AS total_out,
    sum(m.in_qty) - sum(m.out_qty) AS balance_qty,
    i.price AS unit_price,
    (sum(m.in_qty) - sum(m.out_qty)) * i.price AS balance_value,
    max(m.date) AS last_movement_date,
    count(*) AS movement_count
   FROM movements m
     JOIN items i ON i.code = m.item_code
  GROUP BY m.warehouse, m.item_code, i.name, i.unit, i.price;

((current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'rehber'::text])) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM serfiyyat_projects sp
  WHERE ((sp.id = serfiyyat_documents.project_id) AND (sp.linked_warehouse = current_user_warehouse())))))

((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM serfiyyat_documents sd
  WHERE (sd.id = serfiyyat_lines.document_id))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (serfiyyat_documents sd2
     JOIN serfiyyat_projects sp2 ON ((sp2.id = sd2.project_id)))
  WHERE ((sd2.id = serfiyyat_lines.document_id) AND ((current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'rehber'::text])) OR (sp2.linked_warehouse = current_user_warehouse()))))))

   FROM movements m

constraints.name: item_requests_decision_complete
constraints.definition: CHECK (status = 'pending'::text AND decided_by IS NULL AND decided_at IS NULL AND item_code IS NULL OR status = 'approved'::text AND decided_by IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL AND item_code IS NOT NULL OR status = 'rejected'::text AND decided_by IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL AND item_code IS NULL AND length(btrim(COALESCE(decision_reason, ''::text))) > 0 OR status = 'cancelled'::text AND decided_by IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL AND item_code IS NULL)

constraints.name: stock_layer_settings_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (NOT active OR cutover_at IS NOT NULL AND cutover_by IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: stock_layers_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (price_status = 'known'::text AND unit_price > 0::numeric OR price_status = 'free'::text AND unit_price = 0::numeric OR price_status = 'unknown'::text AND unit_price IS NULL)

constraints.name: stock_layers_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (source_type = 'legacy_unresolved'::text AND source_movement_id IS NULL OR source_type <> 'legacy_unresolved'::text)

constraints.name: writeoff_valuations_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (valuation_method = 'admin_override'::text AND final_amount IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(COALESCE(override_reason, ''::text))) > 0 OR valuation_method <> 'admin_override'::text AND override_reason IS NULL)

constraints.name: writeoff_valuations_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (unknown_qty = 0::numeric AND source_amount IS NOT NULL OR unknown_qty > 0::numeric AND source_amount IS NULL)

constraints.name: stock_layer_allocations_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (price_status_snapshot = 'known'::text AND unit_price_snapshot > 0::numeric AND source_amount_snapshot IS NOT NULL OR price_status_snapshot = 'free'::text AND unit_price_snapshot = 0::numeric AND source_amount_snapshot = 0::numeric OR price_status_snapshot = 'unknown'::text AND unit_price_snapshot IS NULL AND source_amount_snapshot IS NULL)

constraints.name: stock_conditions_not_empty
constraints.definition: CHECK (unfit_qty > 0::numeric OR repair_qty > 0::numeric OR onsite_qty > 0::numeric OR icare_qty > 0::numeric OR length(btrim(COALESCE(note, ''::text))) > 0)
